ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-1,
Community Shopping District and B3-3, Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 13-H in the area bounded by:

West Ainslie Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to North Western Avenue; the
alley next north of and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; North Claremont Avenue;
West Lawrence Avenue; and North Western Avenue,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Mall bbe

Matthew J. Martin
Alderman, 47" Ward

Common Addresses:
4801-4857 N. Western Avenue
2334-2348 W. Lawrence Avenue
